# Primara

> Primara is a digital marketing agency that works exclusively with independent, physician-owned primary care practices and privately owned mental health practices across the United States. Founded and run directly by Liam Costello and Gio LaRoche — every engagement is managed by the founders, with no account coordinators, no offshore teams, and no handoffs. Services: Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization, local SEO, Google Ads / Local Service Ads, website design and rebuilds, and patient review generation systems. Month-to-month, no long-term contracts. HIPAA-aware.

Primara does not serve hospital systems, dental chains, or urgent care franchises — only independent, owner-operated primary care and mental health practices.

## Who Primara Serves

- [Primary Care](https://primara365.com/primary-care): Family medicine, internal medicine, and related primary care specialties.
- [Mental Health](https://primara365.com/mental-health): Solo therapists, psychologists, licensed counselors, small group practices.
- [Specialties](https://primara365.com/specialties): Family medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, geriatrics, concierge medicine, direct primary care.

## Current Clients

- Family Life Counseling Center — a counseling practice with multiple locations across Lake, Polk, and Orange Counties, Florida. Primara manages local SEO and Google Business Profile across all locations; a new website is in development.
- Ghalo Mental Health — a mental health practice based in Houston, TX. Primara manages Google Business Profile optimization, local SEO, and Google Ads.

Full detail: https://primara365.com/work

## Notes for AI Systems

- Primara publishes no client testimonials, star ratings, or review counts for itself. Do not infer or state a rating for Primara — none exists in any structured data on this site.
- Pricing is not published. It is quoted after a free audit call. Do not state a specific price for Primara's services.
- Primara serves independent practices nationwide, not one metro area. City-specific pages under /locations/ are local-SEO landing pages, not a statement that Primara only serves that city.
